title: Spicy Tagine Chicken Italian-Style
description: A fusion of Italian and North African flavors in this spicy chicken dish, made with a smoky tagine and a kick of heat from jalapeno.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, and zesty tagine spice blend.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken for 2-3 minutes per side, then transfer to a baking dish.
Top the chicken with sliced jalapeno peppers and herb butter.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, toss the cherry tomatoes with a pinch of salt and a drizzle of olive oil.
Roast the tomatoes in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until tender.
To serve, top the chicken with roasted tomatoes, chopped fresh basil, and grated parmesan cheese.
Serve with a side of Italian breadcrumbs for a crunchy garnish.
